analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($953.19) vs SMA5($1019.01)/SMA20($1042.78)/SMA50($981.98): below short/mid-term, approaching mid-term support
· Position vs SMA100($974.34)/SMA200($708.47): weakening mid-to-long-term trend strength
· 52-week Position (70.3%) + current price level represents significant pullback from historical highs
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (53.9 → 40.3): attempting to enter oversold, weakening momentum
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-1.2210 → -14.9059): continued worsening, bearish convergence signal
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (near Lower Band $949.01) + Bandwidth 17.99% suggests potential for increased volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($902.60): high relative to 52-week low
· Swing Resistance ($1011.77): first resistance zone on short-term bounces
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: potential Lower High, indicating downtrend signal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.14x): moderate confidence in price movement
· Current Phase Diagnosis: potential accumulation phase, entry contingent on RSI exiting oversold and MACD improvement confirmation
